card.name: Object pronoun after a verb
card.fires_on: Short object pronouns, mostly "us" and sometimes "it" or "me", right after a verb like email, tell, warn, twist or ask.

modes.label: "us" after contact or tell verbs
modes.description: The pronoun "us" follows verbs such as email, tell, or warn, often in contact invitations.

modes.label: "it" after handling verbs
modes.description: The pronoun "it" follows a physical action verb like twist or open in instructions.
